$comment: Every assumption baked into the Russell Capital Systems engines, its current value, whether it is sourced or flat, and what would replace it. Verified against the BASE build (claude/base-consolidation) on 2026-09-18. An assumption marked sourced:false is a number the platform currently asserts without evidence.

assumptions.name: HOME_APPRECIATION_RATE
assumptions.note: Now a fallback. When the ZIP appreciation toggle is on, appreciationPath from the FHFA/Zillow record replaces it entirely.
assumptions.replacedBy: appreciationPath — median or 10th-percentile of 10,000 five-year-block bootstrap paths over the ZIP's record

assumptions.name: iulCreditRate (default)
assumptions.note: A header comment at line 14 asserts '7.5% max illustrated rate' under AG 49. The illustrated product's actual AG 49-A maximum illustrated rate is 6.35% (pacificHorizonEcv.ts). Illustrating above a product's maximum illustrated rate is a compliance problem.
assumptions.replacedBy: A per-product maximum illustrated rate table sourced from each carrier's disclosure. See questions.csv Q-03.

assumptions.name: MAX_PREMIUM_YEARS
assumptions.note: Caps the premium funding window. A product decision, not a market fact.

assumptions.name: HELOC_LTV_DEFAULT
assumptions.note: A common lender ceiling, but not verified against any specific lender's published guidelines.
assumptions.replacedBy: Verified lender records from the provider verification brief. See questions.csv Q-01.

assumptions.name: LIFE_LOAN_PCT
assumptions.note: Maximum policy loan as a share of cash value. Carrier-specific in reality.

assumptions.name: MGA_RATE
assumptions.note: Multi-year guaranteed annuity crediting rate used for the interest-savings reinvestment. Real MYGA rates move with the rate environment.
assumptions.replacedBy: A dated MYGA rate table, or a spread over the Treasury curve

assumptions.name: costOfInsurance
assumptions.note: A search for coi, costOfInsurance and insuranceCharge returns nothing in this engine. The IUL policy accumulates with no mortality or expense charges, which materially overstates cash value. This is the most serious defect in the flagship.
assumptions.replacedBy: A per-product COI table by issue age and band, from the carrier's illustration

assumptions.name: loanDragCost
assumptions.status: DEFECT — computed and reported but never deducted
assumptions.note: Calculated at line 297 as cumulativePolicyLoans * loanDragRate and written into the result row at line 342. No total subtracts it. The user is shown a cost that reduces nothing.
assumptions.replacedBy: Deduct from netCashValue, and therefore from netWorth

withdrawnClaims.verdict: DOES NOT EXIST in the BASE build
withdrawnClaims.evidence: netWorth at line 565 = homeEquity + netCashValue - cumulativePropertyTax. Interest saved is not added in. homeEquity at line 545 = homeValue - mortgageBalance - helocBalance, so both debts are correctly netted.
withdrawnClaims.note: This was reported earlier in the session from line numbers belonging to the 688-page build. Corrected here.

withdrawnClaims.evidence: Line 237 is inside the amortization row builder. There is no COI term anywhere in the engine.
withdrawnClaims.note: The real finding is absence, not inversion — which is more serious.

assumptions.name: annual index return table
assumptions.note: These are TOTAL return figures. Index crediting is calculated on PRICE return: 2008 = -38.49%, 2009 = +23.45%. Every illustration built on this table is overstated.
assumptions.replacedBy: shared/indexCreditingData.ts, which already holds the correct price-return series and is used elsewhere in the trunk

assumptions.name: block length for bootstrap resampling
assumptions.note: Five-year blocks preserve medium-term autocorrelation. A defensible convention, stated in the evidence string so a reader can disagree with the number rather than the method.

assumptions.name: default path count
assumptions.note: The owner's stated requirement for the simulation layer.

assumptions.name: default seed
assumptions.note: Fixed so that the same household always sees the same fan. Changing it changes every published illustration.

assumptions.name: minimum growth observations for a path
assumptions.note: Below ten growth observations the engine refuses to produce paths and states the reason rather than extrapolating from a short record.

assumptions.name: bathroomAdjustment
assumptions.note: No public national dataset splits residential rent by bathroom count. Always null, always with the reason. Never estimated.

assumptions.name: deflationCpi
assumptions.note: CPI year-over-year below zero is deflation.

assumptions.name: highCpi
assumptions.note: At or above 5% is an inflation shock.

assumptions.name: stagnantRealGrowth
assumptions.note: High inflation plus non-positive real asset growth is stagflation.

assumptions.name: rateShockRise
assumptions.note: A 2 percentage point rise over the trailing window.

assumptions.name: contractionGrowth
assumptions.note: Non-positive nominal asset growth.

assumptions.name: bubbleMultiple
assumptions.note: Two consecutive years at or above twice the record's long-run mean growth.

assumptions.name: MIN_OBSERVATIONS
assumptions.note: A transition row built on fewer than five observations describes those years, not a probability, and is flagged sparse.

historicalMarketRegimeEngine.note: Every threshold above is reported verbatim in the evidence string returned with each classification, so a reader disagrees with a specific number rather than with 'the model'. All are caller-overridable.

assumptions.name: debt amortization frequency
assumptions.note: Rolled up to annual rows. Annual-only amortization materially understates interest and overstates DSCR.

assumptions.name: DSCR basis
assumptions.note: The lender definition. Underwriting on gross NOI flatters coverage by exactly the reserve.

assumptions.name: exit value basis
assumptions.note: Capitalizes the year after disposition — what a buyer actually underwrites to.

assumptions.name: tranche maturity before disposition
assumptions.note: Implicitly assumes refinance at the same rate. Sets refinanceRequired so the findings engine raises it. The alternative — letting debt vanish at maturity — would silently hand the deal free money.

assumptions.name: state division regime
assumptions.note: Community property versus equitable distribution resolves per state. Any ratio no statute produces is flagged statutory:false with a plain-language basis. Carries rulesVersion and neverPrinted.

assumptions.name: 60/40 and mediated splits
assumptions.note: Marked statutory:false with the text 'No state statute produces this ratio; it is a negotiated or illustrative division.'

globalRules.evidenceContract: Every figure carries {source, asOf, window, method}. Where no public series exists, the value is null with the reason — never an estimate.
globalRules.toggleDefault: off — reproducing the engine's original flat constants exactly, so enabling the evidence layer never silently changes an existing illustration.
globalRules.refusalRule: Tax, statutory and product values are never guessed. Where the rules table has no row, the calculation refuses rather than defaulting.
globalRules.determinism: All resampling is seeded. The same household always sees the same fan.
